xaerorecruits.config.title: Xaero Map Recruits
xaerorecruits.config.show_claims.tooltip: Show faction claims and labels on Xaero's minimap and world map.
xaerorecruits.config.show_on_minimap.too: Show faction labels on the minimap. The world map is not affected.
xaerorecruits.config.world_map_label_sca: Multiplier for faction label size on the world map.
xaerorecruits.config.minimap_label_scale: Multiplier for faction label size on the minimap.
xaerorecruits.config.minimap_label_max_z: Hides minimap labels at zoom levels above this value. Higher zoom means a closer view.
xaerorecruits.config.world_map_min_scale: Hide world-map labels below this map scale. Default 0.25: labels disappear when zoomed out past 0.25x.
xaerorecruits.config.world_map_max_scale: Hide world-map labels above this map scale. Default 4.00: labels disappear when zoomed in past 4x.
xaerorecruits.config.reset.tooltip: Restore all settings to their default values.
